# Comparison fixtures

Small, deterministic CAD pairs that pin the difficult geometry families used
by the diff-cleanup roadmap. All shapes are original synthetic geometry
generated by `scripts/generate_comparison_fixtures.py`; no third-party CAD is
redistributed.

## Cases

- `box.step` / `bored_box.step` — clean exact control: a 40 × 40 × 20 mm box
  and the same box with a Ø12 through-hole.
- `coincident_torus.step` / `coincident_torus_cut.step` — exactly coincident
  curved torus surfaces with a removed segment.
- `single_solid.step` / `overlapping_compound.step` — one solid compared with
  a two-member compound whose members overlap. Raw member volume double-counts
  material; occupied volume must not.
- `covered_rotor_7.step` / `covered_rotor_5.step` — a minimized impeller-like
  case. Blades sit below an unchanged circular plate, so the top view hides the
  meaningful 7-to-5 change while lower viewpoints expose it.

The shared-topology transform case cannot be preserved through STEP because
serialization creates independent topology. `shared_location_pair()` in the
generator returns two differently located shapes that deliberately share one
underlying TShape for in-memory exact-engine tests.

`baseline.json` records the pre-Milestone-3 exact outputs and one machine's
phase timings. The volumes and statuses are regression evidence; the timings
are observational only. Regenerate a live result with:

```bash
.venv/bin/python scripts/capture_comparison_baselines.py
```

To verify that fixture generation is byte-for-byte deterministic without
overwriting the checked-in copies:

```bash
fixture_tmp=$(mktemp -d)
.venv/bin/python scripts/generate_comparison_fixtures.py \
  --output-dir "$fixture_tmp"
diff -rq \
  --exclude README.md \
  --exclude catalog.json \
  --exclude baseline.json \
  tests/fixtures/comparison "$fixture_tmp"
```

To replay a local real-world pair without publishing it:

```bash
.venv/bin/python scripts/capture_comparison_baselines.py \
  --external-reference /path/to/reference.step \
  --external-candidate /path/to/candidate.step \
  --external-only
```

Without `--external-only`, the external pair is appended to all four public
fixture baselines. With it, only the supplied pair runs.

The original manually reported impeller pair remains a local acceptance input:
it is larger than the preferred public fixture budget and has no recorded
redistribution license. Do not copy it into this directory without confirming
that license.
